details: For finite classes, through minimum teaching-set size.
proof: The first layer in the recursive teaching process is $\mathcal H$ itself, so $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)$.  Every minimum teaching set has size at least $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)$, because a smaller one extends to a shattered set of size $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)$; see the proof of the minimum-teaching-set relation.  Combining the two inequalities gives the claim.
name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / Effective VC Radius
